faculty_override_note: The official two-year, four-semester map is the default. The official five-semester map is an alternate lighter-load pathway. DegreeWorks and faculty advisement remain authoritative.
sequence_notes: Both official degree maps' footnote 3 (2-year map) / footnote 6 (5-semester map) state: 'Choose 5 three-credit courses... for a total of 15 credits' for the COM Advised Elective area, but both maps' own course tables show only 4 such slots (12 credits) -- 1 in Semester 2, 1 in Semester 3, 2 in Semester 4 on the two-year map (and the same 4-slot pattern on the five-semester map). The published total of 60 credits only balances using 4 slots (12 credits), not 5 (15 credits); confirmed by reconciling every course and credit value on both maps. Modeled as a 12-credit, 4-course requirement, treating the footnote's '5 courses / 15 credits' text as the likely error. Flagged for maintainer review.

COM Advised Elective's full official eligibility list is broader than what is modeled: 'SPE xx, COM xxx, THE xxx, GWS xxx, MES 152, ENG xxx, MAR 100, MAR 220, MAR 230, BUS 150, or ANY social science course', with a sub-rule requiring at least three of the four chosen courses to come from SPE/COM/THE/GWS specifically. Modeled as a subject-wildcard pool restricted to SPE/COM/THE/GWS plus the specific named courses (MAR 100, MAR 220, MAR 230, BUS 150, MES 152); the open-ended 'any ENG course' and 'any social science course' allowances, and the at-least-three sub-rule, are not enforced -- the sub-rule has no primitive in the current schema (similar to the Sociology Flexible Core cross-group cap), and 'any social science course' has no fixed definition in this footnote to safely enumerate. Flagged for maintainer review.
COM Program Elective (2 courses, 6 credits): 'Choose 2 courses from any Communication courses.' Modeled as a subject-wildcard pool restricted to COM.

THE 100 has three alternates: MES 153, MUS 107, or ART 106. Modeled as a four-way alternative cluster (THE 100 as the hub, each alternate reciprocally linked back to it) using the same `alternativeComponents()` graph-traversal mechanism as every other reciprocal-alternatives pair in this repo.

COM 240 and COM 245 both officially require 'SPE 100 or permission of department'; encoded as `SPE 100` (the permission-of-department alternate is not course-based). COM 255 requires 'SPE 100 or SPE 102' exactly, and is encoded as such.

The subject-wildcard COM Advised Elective pool (SPE/COM/THE/GWS) can include courses already separately required elsewhere in this same curriculum (e.g. SPE 100 itself, or COM 240/245/255) -- the schema has no mechanism to exclude already-used codes from an auto-populated wildcard pool. This is the same category of limitation already documented for Sociology's cross-listed AFN/LAT courses. Flagged for maintainer review.

LIN 150's home department course-listing page could not be located (not found under Speech, Communications and Theatre Arts or English); its title and credits are sourced from both official degree maps, which agree exactly. No prerequisite was found or encoded.
Life and Physical Sciences and Scientific World are both footnoted only with advisory 'consult an advisor' language and are left as the standard, unrestricted shared pools.
A Writing Intensive course is needed to fulfill the graduation requirement.
